initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the data cannot measure motorist fatality risk per mile because it contains no miles-driven or vehicle-miles-traveled exposure; it can show annual counts of reported motorist deaths as an outcome-only proxy
initial_plan.metric: annual number of motorist deaths (sum of number_of_motorist_killed)
initial_plan.denominator: none; this is a count, not a per-mile rate
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC crash records with a usable crash_date year and nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed; count motorist deaths reported on those crashes
initial_plan.years: calendar years 2013-2025 inclusive, assigned from crash_date

data_check.meaning_and_decisions: Among nonmissing crash dates in 2013-2025, all 2,132,218 crash rows have a nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed, so no in-window rows are removed for the measure. There are 0 crash rows with missing crash_date in the file, which are unassignable to a year. Each year from 2013 through 2025 has crash-date endpoints of Jan 1 and Dec 31; this does not establish daily reporting completeness, so retain all years and disclose this caveat (including for 2025). Date is a typed DATE, and no impossible/default date value appears in the selected interval. Keep the eligible rows; do not impute or exclude any based on unobserved exposure.
data_check.changed_from_initial_plan: No metric or population change; the data check confirms no missing motorist-death values in the selected window and adds the date-coverage caveat.

final_plan.can_answer_question: no for risk per mile: vehicle-miles-traveled is absent; partly for the outcome-only proxy of annual motorist deaths
final_plan.metric: annual count of reported motorist deaths, calculated as the sum of number_of_motorist_killed
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC crashes dated in calendar years 2013-2025 with a nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed value; the count is of persons classified as motorists killed on those crash records
filters: crash_date is nonmissing and its calendar year is 2013-2025
final_plan.limitations: The data has no vehicle-miles-traveled or other miles-driven exposure, so the plotted fatality counts cannot establish whether risk per mile declined. The 2025 date endpoints span Jan 1 through Dec 31, as do the other years, but date endpoints do not establish complete reporting on every day; police-reported crashes only are represented. No crash-date or motorist-death values are missing among the 2,132,218 dated rows in the selected years; 0 records have missing crash_date in the file.
